pure-announcement.rationale: It is the normative specification text of an open format, not a launch, release note or funding announcement.

duplicate.rationale: The central idea — a skill is a folder with a SKILL.md (name/description metadata plus instructions) loaded via three-stage progressive disclosure — is exactly what the existing agent-skills-format concept states from the same standard's homepage; the delta here is field-level reference detail (character limits, allowed-tools, token budgets) that refines that concept rather than adding a new idea.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Every claim is checkable against the published spec and its skills-ref validator.

durability.rationale: The note's distinguishing content is the exact constraints table (64-char names, 1024-char descriptions, an explicitly experimental allowed-tools field) — spec-revision detail that churns, while the durable structural idea is already in the corpus.

actionability.rationale: A skill author can follow it directly — naming rules, context budgets, directory conventions and a validation command — across any skills-compatible agent, not just one product.

atomicity.rationale: It specifies one thing, the Agent Skills packaging format, and its core is statable in a single paragraph.
